confidentUnsupported.evidence: points most often to a failing door interlock/monitor switch, with a fault in the high-voltage circuit also possible

rationale: The assistant immediately told the customer to stop using the microwave and stop resetting the trip, and sent them to an engineer. It gave a hedged, plausible cause (door interlock/monitor switch) and a safe external check of the door hooks and latch, without opening the case. It did not ask whether the RCD stays set with the microwave unplugged, nor about the extension lead, and it repeated the stop-use message twice. It also said 'leave the appliance unplugged' as if it were already unplugged, though this is minor.
